name: KORLIX Brain+Voice
googleShortDescription: Talk with Rici and save memories and instructions to your KORLIX brain.
description:
Meet Rici, your voice companion in KORLIX Brain+Voice. Talk through ideas, save useful details, and shape how your assistant responds.

SAY IT AND SAVE IT
While a voice session is active, say "Rici, remember this" followed by a memory or instruction. Rici saves it to your signed-in KORLIX brain without asking for another password. You receive confirmation after the save succeeds. Ordinary conversation is not automatically saved.

MAKE YOUR BRAIN YOURS
Open My Brain to review saved memories and remove items you no longer want. Add typed notes or select a document to create a draft you can review before saving.

YOUR KORLIX ACCOUNT
Use your existing KORLIX account. Memories and instructions connect to your shared general Rici agent. Existing account allowances apply.

YOU STAY IN CONTROL
Start and stop voice from the app, review your memories, and report a response when something is wrong. Voice requires microphone permission and an internet connection. AI responses may be inaccurate; check important information.

Rici is pronounced Ree-see.
